channel.title: Ruth and Jonah, Chapter by Chapter
channel.copyright: © 2026 Honest Little Apps. Scripture: World English Bible (public domain).
channel.description:
A short Bible study you can follow on a walk or lead with a small group. Each episode reads one full chapter of Ruth or Jonah from the World English Bible (public domain), then asks three questions about what happened, with the verse that answers each one.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Wayfold: Understand the Bible, an iPhone Bible study app where Ruth and Jonah, with printable leader guides, are free. Wayfold: Understand the Bible on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
